summary: LLM API pricing in late 2026 spans a wide range, from sub-$0.20 per million input tokens for lightweight models to $15+ for flagship reasoning models like Claude Opus. Prompt caching discounts (typically 75-90% off cached input) and batch processing (usually 50% off) are now standard cost-reduction levers across OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Mid-tier production models have converged around $2-3 per million input tokens, while competitive price cuts continue to push the floor lower.

models.name: GPT-4o
models.notes: Batch API offers 50% discount on input/output. Cached input priced at 50% of standard input rate.

models.name: GPT-4o mini
models.notes: Low-cost model for high-volume tasks. Batch API offers 50% discount; cached input at 50% of standard rate.

models.name: Claude Sonnet 4.6
models.notes: Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input price; cache writes at 1.25x. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: Free tier available with rate limits. Pricing for text/image/video input. Implicit caching supported.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
models.notes: Free tier with rate limits. Tiered pricing applies above 200K context tokens (higher rates). Implicit caching only.

models.name: o4-mini
models.notes: Reasoning model. Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API offers 50% discount; cached input at 25% of standard rate.

models.name: o3
models.notes: Flagship reasoning model (price reduced in 2026). Output includes reasoning tokens. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Fast, low-cost model. Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input price. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Flagship model for complex reasoning. Prompt caching reads at ~10% of input price; cache writes at 1.25x. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Grok (grok-4)
models.notes: Flagship Grok model. Cached input at 25% of standard rate. Higher rates may apply for extended context.

models.name: Mistral Large
models.notes: Free tier available via La Plateforme for experimentation. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Mistral Small
models.notes: Low-cost model. Free tier available via La Plateforme. Batch API offers 50% discount.

models.name: Llama (hosted)
models.notes: Pricing varies by model size (e.g., Llama 3.3 70B). Open-weight model hosted on third-party inference platforms; rates differ across Together AI, Groq, and Fireworks.

models.name: Command R+
models.notes: Free trial API keys available with rate limits. Optimized for RAG and tool use.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
models.notes: Very low-cost model. Off-peak discount pricing applies (lower rates during specified UTC hours, weekends, and holidays). Cache hits heavily discounted.
